title: physio/golden.json
description: physio/golden.json (v1.1.5): WS2's physiology, speed-governor, O2, haul, margin, turn-back and dose-leash test vectors (pipeline/engine/golden.py). Any port (the simulator's C# port, D41) is accepted when it reproduces every case within the tolerance the file states for that case group (tolerances.{group}: |got - want| <= abs + rel * |want|). Loose by design: the envelope is checked here; each case is {id, inputs, expected} as WS2 documents in the file (units, coords = pad-local metres, conventions, config, formulas). Producer WS2; copied by make web; included in every plan bundle (contracts/bundle/README.md). Extra keys allowed.
x-source: SPEC §11 D41 (set A); handover page "EVA simulation module" part A (physio/golden.json); WS2 pipeline/engine/golden.py

cases.description: case group -> list of cases; groups: physio, o2_leg, haul, haul_drag_finding, margin, turn_back, dose_leash, route (WS2 may add groups)

config.description: the config values the vectors were generated with (crew, variants, derived constants, formulas)
